title: Blade Runner 2049
tagline: Rain, neon and a hot bowl of noodles.
about: A replicant blade runner finds a secret that could change the world, and goes looking for the man who vanished thirty years ago.
cue: Serve the drinks when K finds Deckard in the empty Las Vegas casino.
faces: Open 11 am till late, every day.
+ Joi, a hologram who cooks for him
I've never had real food. Joi cooks dinner for me every night. It looks perfect. It just isn't there.

    StartersProtein farm grub-free skewersGrilled white miso and garlic chicken thigh skewers with a soy sesame dipHow to make it600g chicken thighs, diced2 tbsp white miso2 cloves of garlic2 tbsp soy sauce1 tsp sesame oil2 spring onionsMix the miso with crushed garlic and coat the chicken.Marinate for an hour.Thread onto skewers.Grill until charred.Mix soy, sesame oil and sliced spring onion for dipping.Rainy LA street mushroom gyozaPan-fried mushroom, tofu and cabbage gyoza with soy, black vinegar and chilli oilHow to make it250g mushrooms, finely chopped200g firm tofu2 cups of shredded wombok1 tsp salt30 dumpling wrappers1 tbsp oil2 tbsp soy sauce2 tbsp black vinegar1 tbsp chilli oilSalt the wombok, then squeeze it dry and mix with the mushrooms, crumbled tofu and a splash of the soy.Fill the wrappers and pleat.Fry in the oil until crisp underneath.Add water and steam.Serve with the rest of the soy, black vinegar and chilli oil.Wooden horse soft pretzels with mustardThe small wooden horse K carves into his memoryHow to make itAs written, serves 4Soft pretzel twists dipped in bicarb water, sprinkled with rock salt and baked deep brown, served warm with a honey and wholegrain mustard dip.Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour.Divide into 8, roll into long ropes and twist into pretzels.Boil 2L water with 60g bicarb soda and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds.Sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220°C for 12 minutes.Mix 3 tbsp wholegrain mustard with 2 tbsp honey to dip.Roasted garlic bulbs with sourdoughSapper's pot, still going on the stove.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsJoi's rib eye, mash and red wine jusSeared rib eye, buttery mashed potatoes, green beans and red wine jusHow to make it2 rib eye steaks1kg potatoes60g butter300g green beans150ml red wine250ml beef stockBoil the potatoes and mash with butter.Reduce the red wine with stock into a jus.Sear the steaks hard.Rest and slice the steaks.Steam the green beans.Plate it like a proper dinner and pour the jus over.Off-world miso ramen with pork bellyThe off-world ads glowing over the rainy cityHow to make itAs written, serves 4Ramen noodles in a rich pork and miso broth with seared soy-braised pork belly, jammy soy eggs, corn, nori and spring onion.Simmer 600g pork belly in 100ml soy, 100ml mirin and 500ml water for 90 minutes, then slice and sear.Boil 4 eggs for 6.5 minutes, peel and soak in some of the braising liquid.Heat 1.5L chicken stock, whisk in 4 tbsp white miso and 2 tbsp of the braising liquid.Cook 4 portions of ramen noodles.Fill bowls with noodles and broth and top with pork, halved eggs, corn, nori and spring onion.SweetsSnowfall panna cottaVanilla panna cotta in glasses with crushed meringue on topHow to make it3 gelatine sheets400ml thickened cream200ml full cream milk80g caster sugar1 vanilla bean2 meringue nestsSoak the gelatine sheets in cold water.Warm the cream, milk, sugar and split vanilla bean.Stir in the squeezed gelatine and pour into glasses.Set in the fridge overnight.Crush the meringue nests over the top like falling snow.DrinksDeckard's Scotch and honey highballScotch, honey syrup and lemon topped with cold ginger aleHow to make it2 tbsp honey2 tbsp hot water180ml Scotch whisky1 lemon480ml cold ginger ale1 bag iceStir the honey into hot water to loosen and cool.Fill four tall glasses with ice and add Scotch, honey syrup and lemon juice, then stir.Top each with ginger ale and stir once more.Twist a strip of lemon peel over the top and drop it in.Smoked rye old fashionedDeckard pours one for the dog too.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
